record.title: Cleaning the code and improving the documentation
Nakama configuration changes
record.body:
<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Refactor**
  * Centralized configuration values into named constants for improved readability and maintainability. No changes to application behavior or user-facing features.
  * Also, Amazon Q suggested removing the memory value in the Fargate Service. More information:

> The Problem
> Your service is overriding the task definition memory with lower values:
> 
> Production: Task says 3072 MB, Service overrides to 2048 MB
> 
> Development: Task says 2048 MB, Service overrides to 1024 MB
> 
> Fix
> Remove the service-level override since you already defined it in the task


<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
